description: AI news digest Sep 22: MiMo-V2.6 open weights, single-GPU Xing agent, MiniMax Code, JetBrains Air, Plugin4Shell, Grok 4.7.
lead: Open weights with receipts, agents that fit on one GPU, and a hard lesson in plugin pinning. Xiaomi published both its new flagship models and the multi-million-dollar training bill behind them, a 29B agentic model targets a single consumer graphics card, MiniMax open-sourced a terminal coding agent, JetBrains stitched its agent tooling into one system, researchers showed how a git naming trick defeats plugin locks on four coding agents, Claude Code learned to read the shared AGENTS.md format, and Grok 4.7 pushed coding speed up and prices down. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 22, 2026: open agent models, JetBrains Air, coding-agent security
